title: Five Big Questions for the 2028 Presidential Race
summary: Will JD Vance and Marco Rubio run? What about Kamala Harris and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez? And, of course, what role will President Trump play?
caption: The 2028 race for the White House is quietly taking shape, even though no major candidates have announced campaigns yet.

title: Planning Board to Hold Last-Minute Meeting to Consider Trump’s D.C. Construction
summary: President Trump will lose control over the National Capital Planning Commission after Democrats take control of Congress in January. It could give final approval to some of his prized projects.
caption: East Potomac Park last month, one of the sites of President Trump’s proposed construction projects around the city.

title: In Democrats vs. Trump, the Loser May Be Federal Contractors
summary: The incoming Democratic majorities have begun targeting businesses and other outsiders in their planned inquiries, but the president has threatened to fire them if they comply without his permission.
caption: President Trump signed an executive order requiring federal contractors to seek permission from the White House before complying with a congressional oversight demand.
tags: House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform
